listing.name: ElvenSector 0.1.7 -  Gacha Edition
listing.aiSummary: Adds two new elven factions with steampunk-themed ships, unique NPCs, and new systems to the sector.

description:
Introducing:

ElvenSector

Have you ever thought to yourself

: "Man I really wish there was a mod that added knife-ear elf waifus to my favourite 2D spaceship video game?" No? Well,

better late than never.

8)

Now with goblins.

Sprites (non exhaustive)

SpoilerCicada-class Frigate

Swallowtail-class Gunship Destroyer

Mothwing-class Fast Cruiser

Lacewing-class Superfreighter

Chrysopa-class Modified Superfreighter

Onslaught (DM)-class Battleship

Available through MagicBounty System

[close]

Introducing the

Dökkálfar Mechanicus

, the first of several elven factions to be added. With a specialty in building steampunk ships powered in part by magic, their ships come with a special built in hullmod, Ley Line Circuits, which increases their maneuverability and top speed with flux level, leaning into their specialty of hit-and-run, high alpha-strike ships.

Newly introducing the

Hellisálfur

, the "cave elves", or goblins. They field warship conversions of Dökkálfar Mechanicus logistics ships, and can be found in Dökkálfar III, a black hole fortress system.

Some of the new faces to be seen in the Sector:

Spoiler

[close]

Disclaimers regarding AI image generation use:

SpoilerStablediffusion used for generating: all ship sprites, all weapon sprites, all character portraits

List of used models (potential nsfw warning on following links):

homebrew model trained on only vanilla starsector sprites

https://civitai.com/models/20830/steampunkai-10mb-lora-extraction

https://civitai.com/models/6755?modelVersionId=78676

[close]

Guide to new content:

SpoilerAttain Favourable reputation with Dökkálfar Mechanicus to unlock dialogue option with Bereth to add her as potential contact.

Reach 50 Rep with Bereth and Favourable reputation with Dökkálfar Mechanicus to unlock dialogue option to recruit Noelani.

[close]

Changes(0.1.7):

Spoiler-Added new Systems Dökkálfar II and Dökkálfar IV

-Moved location of Dökkálfar I and Dökkálfar III

-Added Gacha NPC on Hamingja Station.

-Added ability to gain Bereth as contact.[close]

Changes(0.1.5):

Spoiler-Added Botfly, Dungbeetle, Formicidae and Lacewing to Dökkálfar Mechanicus.

-Added Hellisálfur and Dökkálfar III

-Added Gadfly, Stinkbug, Termite and Chrysopa to Hellisálfur

-Added Onslaught (DM)

-Added "The Elvenslaught" MagicBounty

-Added unique NPCs Bereth and Berenil with some lore interaction dialogue (will be expanded upon in a later update)

[close]

Special thanks to: Turkler, for letting me copy some code and rules.csv stuff

aiDescription: Introduces the Dökkálfar Mechanicus and Hellisálfur factions, featuring ships with a special hullmod that boosts speed based on flux levels. Includes new systems, a gacha NPC, and recruitable contacts with lore dialogue. Ships are available through the MagicBounty system.
